options_en: Data-structure design: compose structures from the required operations.

optionExplanations: 先列出各操作要求的复杂度，再挑基础结构组合，这正是设计一个类+多操作复杂度的标志信号。
题目没有任何文本匹配需求，正则解决不了同时要查找、删除、排序的组合问题。

DFS only traverses a graph; it says nothing about which structures to combine when several operations need different costs.

q: 哪些信号说明你可能需要组合多个数据结构？

题目只要求把一个数组求和

why_en: Conflicting operation costs, class-design framing, and known product shapes are strong composition signals.
options_en: Multiple operations have seemingly conflicting complexity requirements.
The problem explicitly asks you to design a class.
It's a familiar product feature mapped to a known shape, like LRU, a leaderboard, or autocomplete.
The problem only asks you to sum one array.

termDefinitions.meaning: 最近最少使用缓存淘汰策略：优先淘汰最久没被访问的数据。

optionExplanations: 操作复杂度互相打架时，单一结构装不下，这是最强的组合信号，提示你要拆两个结构分工。

An explicit 'design a class' framing usually means the interviewer wants you to name structures and their roles out loud, not just hand back functions.
Mapping a product feature straight onto a known composition (LRU, leaderboard, autocomplete) saves you from deriving it from scratch.

q: 应组合哪两个结构？

whenOtherWins: 如果语言允许直接用 OrderedDict 或 LinkedHashMap 且面试不要求从零实现，内置结构更快；但展示理解时应说明底层组合。

正则做文本匹配、栈做后进先出，两者都不提供按 key 查找，跟这道题的需求完全不搭。
optionExplanations_en: A single array forces a tradeoff: fast key lookup or fast reordering, never both at O(1).
The map finds a node by key while the list moves it to the front or drops it from the back, together covering both O(1) requirements.
A min-heap is good at extremes and DFS is good at traversal, but neither gives you O(1) lookup by key.
Regex handles text matching and a stack is LIFO — neither offers key-based lookup, so both miss what this problem needs.

q: 为什么 LRU 缓存不能只用哈希表，也不能只用双向链表？
q_en: Why can't an LRU cache use only a hash map or only a doubly linked list?
options: 只用链表也能给节点建 O(1) 的 key 索引
给哈希表的 value 加时间戳就能替代链表顺序
哈希表没有顺序信息，链表按 key 查找要 O(n)
两者都不支持 O(1) 删除头尾节点
why: LRU 同时要求按 key 直接定位和按最近使用顺序移动/淘汰。两个结构各补一半能力。
why_en: The hash map supplies direct lookup while the linked list supplies recency ordering.
tradeoff: 按 key 直接定位 vs 按最近使用顺序移动/淘汰
options_en: A linked list alone can also give O(1) key indexing.
Adding a timestamp field to the hash map value can replace the linked list's ordering.
A hash map has no ordering, and finding a node by key in a linked list is O(n).
Neither structure supports O(1) removal of the head or tail node.

optionExplanations: 链表本身没有索引结构，按 key 找节点还是得从头遍历比较，不会因为只用链表就变成 O(1)。
时间戳能排序，但找最旧值仍要扫描所有 value 逐个比较，并没有省掉那次 O(n) 扫描。
哈希表只管查找、不记顺序，链表只管顺序、按 key 找要挨个比对，两者正好各缺对方那一半。
双向链表本来就能 O(1) 删头尾节点，问题出在按 key 查找，不是头尾删除。
optionExplanations_en: A list has no index of its own — finding a node by key still means walking it node by node, not O(1).
A timestamp gives you an order, but finding the oldest one still means scanning every value, so it doesn't remove that O(n) cost.
A hash map has no ordering and a list has no O(1) key lookup — each is missing exactly the half the other supplies.
A doubly linked list already removes its head or tail in O(1); the real gap is key lookup, not head/tail deletion.
scenario: 实现容量 1000 的 LRU 缓存，get/put 都必须 O(1)，满了淘汰最久未使用项。
scenario_en: You implement an LRU cache of capacity 1000 where get and put must both be O(1), evicting the least recently used entry when full.

why_en: LRU moves hits to the head and evicts the tail while keeping the map in sync.

q: 这些哨兵节点最主要的价值是什么？
q_en: What is the main value of these sentinel nodes?
codeSample:
self.head = Node()
self.tail = Node()
self.head.next = self.tail
self.tail.prev = self.head
options: 自动处理容量为负数
把哈希表查找变成 O(log n)
避免空链表、首尾节点删除等边界分支
让链表变成单向链表
why: 哨兵节点让插入头部、删除尾部、删除任意节点都走同一套指针逻辑。少写特殊分支，AI 代码更容易正确。
why_en: Sentinel nodes remove edge-case branches for empty lists and head or tail updates.
whenOtherWins: 如果使用语言内置的有序映射，哨兵细节被库封装；手写链表时哨兵通常更稳。

options_en: It automatically handles a negative capacity.
It turns hash-map lookup into O(log n).
It removes edge-case branches for an empty list and head/tail node removal.
It turns the list into a singly linked list.

termDefinitions.meaning: 链表头尾各放一个不存数据的占位节点，让插入/删除不用判断空表或首尾特殊情况。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A sentinel node is a placeholder at the head or tail of a list that removes special-case branches for empty lists or boundary edits.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个节点同时保存前驱和后继指针，可 O(1) 在已知节点处插入或删除。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A doubly linked list keeps prev and next pointers on every node, allowing O(1) insert or delete at a known node.

optionExplanations: capacity 是否为负是业务层校验的事，哨兵节点不处理任何参数合法性。
哈希表查找复杂度只取决于哈希表本身，跟链表用不用哨兵毫无关系。
手写链表最容易在空表、头尾节点、单节点这几处边界忘记判断，哨兵把这些分支统一成一套指针逻辑处理掉。
哨兵节点不改变指针方向，链表照样保留前驱和后继两个方向。
optionExplanations_en: Whether capacity is negative is an input-validation concern; sentinels don't touch it.
Hash-map lookup complexity depends only on the hash map itself, not on whether the list uses sentinels.
Hand-written lists most often bug on edge cases like an empty list or head/tail removal — sentinels remove those branches, worth spelling out to the AI.
Sentinels don't change pointer direction — the list still keeps both prev and next links.

why_en: Leaving the old node in the list breaks the invariant between the map and the linked list.
options_en: No effect at all: the hash map cleans up the old node by itself.
Complexity automatically drops to O(1) because a delete is skipped.
The hash map ends up holding two conflicting entries for the same key.
The stale node for that key stays in the list, so tail eviction removes the wrong state.

scenario_en: Edges arrive online one at a time and you must answer 'are these two connected' at any moment, with no path to output.

q: 把数据结构设计的一般流程按正确顺序排列。
q_en: Put the general data-structure design flow in the correct order.
steps: 为组合后的结构命名不变量，并把它们放进 AI 提示或代码审查清单。
逐个匹配到基础结构，例如哈希表、堆、链表、树、队列。
列出所有操作、返回值和复杂度要求。
检查单一基础结构是否足够；不够时组合两个或三个。
让 AI 按指定 API 实现，然后用边界操作追踪不变量。
why: 先操作后结构，再不变量和验证。这个流程能让你解释为什么选择某个组合，而不是只说见过这题。
why_en: The robust design flow is operations, primitives, composition, invariants, and invariant-driven verification.
diagram:
flowchart TD
A[Read API] --> B[For each op list needs]
B --> C[Choose structures]
C --> D[Define sync rules]
D --> E[Check complexity]
tradeoff: 操作驱动结构选择 vs 直接套用记忆中的结构名

q: 哪些“操作 → 基础结构”的匹配是合理的？
q_en: Which operation-to-primitive-structure matches are reasonable?
options: O(1) 按 key 查找 → 哈希表
O(log n) 取最小或最大 → 堆
给定节点指针 O(1) 删除 → 双向链表
需要有序区间查询 → 纯哈希表
why: 哈希表、堆、链表分别服务于 lookup、优先级、指针删除。区间或有序遍历需要排序数组、平衡树或有序集合。
why_en: Primitive choice follows the operation: maps for lookup, heaps for extrema, linked lists for pointer-based removal.
options_en: O(1) lookup by key maps to a hash map.
O(log n) getting the min or max maps to a heap.
O(1) removal given a node pointer maps to a doubly linked list.
Ordered range queries map to a plain hash map.

termDefinitions.meaning: 键值映射结构，平均 O(1) 按 key 查找、插入、删除。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash map is a key-value structure offering average O(1) lookup, insert, and delete by key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 能在 O(log n) 插入、O(1) 读取最值的树形结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A heap is a tree-based structure with O(log n) insert and O(1) access to its extreme value.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个节点同时保存前驱和后继指针，可 O(1) 在已知节点处插入或删除。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A doubly linked list keeps prev and next pointers on every node, allowing O(1) insert or delete at a known node.

termDefinitions.meaning: 并查集：维护一组不相交集合，支持合并（union）和查询代表元（find）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Union-Find, or disjoint-set union, maintains groups of elements and supports merging groups and finding a group's representative.

optionExplanations: 按 key 拿值的需求第一反应就该想哈希表，平均 O(1) 完成查找、插入、删除。
要极值时堆是最直接的选择，插入 O(log n)、取最值 O(1) 顶端读取。
已知节点位置要 O(1) 删除时，双向链表的前驱后继指针正好能做到。
哈希表不维护任何顺序，拿它做有序区间查询只会退化成整表扫描。
optionExplanations_en: Get-by-key needs should reflexively point to a hash map, averaging O(1) for lookup, insert, and delete.
For extrema, a heap is the direct pick: O(log n) insert and a constant-time read of the current min or max.
When you already have a node pointer and need O(1) removal, a doubly linked list's prev/next pointers do exactly that.
A hash map keeps no order at all, so using it for ordered range queries just degrades into scanning the whole table.
scenario: 设计一个类：要 O(1) 按 key 查找、O(log n) 取最值、给定节点指针 O(1) 删除。
scenario_en: Design a class needing O(1) lookup by key, O(log n) access to the min or max, and O(1) removal given a node pointer.

q: 静态数据和动态数据对结构选择的影响是什么？
q_en: How do static and dynamic data affect structure choice?
options: 静态还是动态对结构选择完全没有影响
动态数据只能存在普通数组里，没有别的选择
静态数据本身没排序，用不了依赖有序的二分查找
静态数据先排序后二分；高频增删则用树/堆/哈希
why: 静态数据允许一次性预处理，后续用二分或前缀结构。频繁插入删除时，维护排序数组可能太贵，要改用支持更新的结构。
why_en: Static data favors preprocessing, while dynamic data favors structures that maintain invariants under updates.
tradeoff: 一次性预处理换查询简单 vs 维护动态更新下的结构成本
options_en: Static versus dynamic makes no difference to structure choice.
Dynamic data can only live in a plain array, there is no other option.
Static data has never been sorted, so it can't use an algorithm that depends on ordering.
Sort static data once and binary-search it; frequent inserts and deletes call for a tree, heap, or hash.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在有序数据上每次排除一半候选，O(log n) 定位目标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Binary search halves the candidate range each step, locating a target in O(log n) time on sorted data.

optionExplanations: 更新频率恰恰是决定结构的关键变量，忽略它会让排序数组在频繁增删下维护成本失控。
动态数据完全可以用树、堆、哈希表等多种结构，并不局限于数组。
静态数据正是二分查找最擅长的场景，前提只是先排一次序。
静态数据一次排序后就能反复二分查询；动态数据频繁增删时维护排序数组太贵，改用树/堆/哈希更划算。
optionExplanations_en: Update frequency is precisely the deciding variable — ignoring it lets a sorted array's maintenance cost spiral under frequent changes.
Dynamic data can perfectly well use trees, heaps, or hash maps; it's not limited to arrays.
Static data is exactly where binary search shines, as long as you sort it once up front.
Sort static data once and binary-search it repeatedly; for frequent insert/delete, maintaining a sorted array gets expensive, so a tree, heap, or hash map pays off more.
scenario: 同一批 100 万条评分数据要支持范围查询：一个版本只读，另一个每秒上千次增删。
scenario_en: The same one million scored records need range queries: one version is read-only, the other takes thousands of inserts and deletes per second.

q: 组合数据结构最容易出错的地方是什么？
q_en: Where do composed data structures most often go wrong?
options: 代码注释写得太少必然会导致运行超时
函数和变量命名风格太随意、太简短
多个结构保存相关状态，但某次操作只更新了其中一部分
只要用了两个结构，正确性就没办法靠测试验证清楚了
why: LRU 的 map/list、MedianFinder 的两堆、带索引的堆都依赖同步不变量。AI 常能写 happy path，但会漏掉边界操作里的同步。
why_en: Composition bugs usually come from updating one structure without updating the related one.
options_en: Too few code comments will necessarily cause a runtime timeout.
Function and variable naming style is too casual and too short.
Multiple structures hold related state, but one operation only updates part of them.
Using two structures always makes correctness impossible to verify with tests.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个组合结构在每次操作后都必须仍然成立的性质。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An invariant is a property that must still hold true after every operation on a composed structure.

termDefinitions.meaning: 键值映射结构，平均 O(1) 按 key 查找、插入、删除。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash map is a key-value structure offering average O(1) lookup, insert, and delete by key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个节点同时保存前驱和后继指针，可 O(1) 在已知节点处插入或删除。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A doubly linked list keeps prev and next pointers on every node, allowing O(1) insert or delete at a known node.

optionExplanations: 运行超时通常来自算法复杂度选错，跟注释多少没有因果关系。
命名风格是可读性问题，不影响状态是否真的保持同步。
多个结构本该同步更新却只改了一部分，这是组合数据结构里最常踩的坑，跟 LRU 里哈希表和链表要对齐是同一类问题。
只要不变量写清楚，两个结构一样可以逐步验证，结构数量不是问题所在。
optionExplanations_en: A timeout almost always traces back to algorithmic complexity, nothing to do with comment count.
Naming style is a readability concern; it doesn't affect whether state actually stays in sync.
Related state split across two structures but only one gets updated — the classic composed-structure bug, like an LRU map and list drifting apart.
As long as the invariant is stated clearly, two structures verify just as well; the count of structures isn't the issue.
scenario: AI 生成了哈希表 + 双向链表的 LRU，happy path 测试全过，你要指出它的主要风险。
scenario_en: The AI generated an LRU from a hash map plus a doubly linked list and the happy-path tests all pass, but you must name its main risk.

scenario: 题目同时要求按 key O(1) 查找，又要按分数有序迭代或取范围。
scenario_en: The problem requires O(1) lookup by key and ordered iteration or range queries by score.
q: 合理的设计方向是什么？
q_en: What is a reasonable design direction?
options: 把所有查询都退化成随机的全表扫描
只用一个无序哈希集合，要有序时得现场全量排序
只用一个先进先出的队列结构装全部数据
哈希表管 key 查找，配一个有序结构管排序
why: O(1) 查找和有序范围查询是不同维度的需求，通常需要双结构同步。关键是说清两者如何保持一致。
why_en: When lookup and ordering are both required, pair a hash map with an ordered structure and maintain consistency.
whenOtherWins: 如果只需要查找、不需要有序遍历，单个哈希表更简单；如果只需要有序扫描，排序数组或树可能够用。
tradeoff: O(1) 按 key 查找 vs 保持一个排序维度可迭代
options_en: Let every query degrade into a random full-table scan.
Use one unordered hash set, and re-sort the whole thing from scratch whenever order is needed.
Put all the data in a single FIFO queue.
A hash map handles key lookup, paired with an ordered structure for the sorted dimension.

termDefinitions.meaning: 键值映射结构，平均 O(1) 按 key 查找、插入、删除。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash map is a key-value structure offering average O(1) lookup, insert, and delete by key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个组合结构在每次操作后都必须仍然成立的性质。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An invariant is a property that must still hold true after every operation on a composed structure.

optionExplanations: 放弃任何结构优化，让每次查询代价随数据量线性增长，规模一大就顶不住。
哈希集合能查找但不维护顺序，遇到范围查询只能退化成扫描全部再排序。
队列只保证先进先出，既不支持按 key 查找，也不维护分数排序，两个需求都答不上。
哈希表专管按 key 查找，另一个有序结构专管排序维度，两者同步更新，正面满足查找+有序两个并存的需求。
optionExplanations_en: Abandoning any structural optimization makes every query cost grow linearly with data size, breaking down as it scales.
A hash set supports lookup but keeps no order, so a range query would degrade to scanning everything and sorting afterward.
A queue only guarantees first-in-first-out order — it answers neither the key-lookup nor the score-ordering requirement.
One piece answers lookup by key, another keeps the sorted order, and the two stay in sync on every update — together covering both needs at once.

scenario: 你已经决定了结构组合，准备让 AI 写代码。
scenario_en: You have chosen the structure composition and are ready to ask the AI to write the code.
q: 提示中最应该明确哪两类信息？
q_en: Which two kinds of information should the prompt make explicit?
options: 只说一句“写得优雅一点、别太啰嗦”
结构名称与角色，加上类 API 的签名与返回值
要求 AI 不写任何测试，先出实现再说
让 AI 自己揣摩需求和复杂度目标，接口全交给它定
why: AI 很擅长按明确 API 和结构角色补代码。模糊提示会让它发明接口或用掉展示不了理解的捷径。
why_en: A good prompt names each structure's role and the exact API the class must expose.
whenOtherWins: 探索阶段可以先问 AI 有哪些设计选择；一旦选定方案，提示应变得具体。
tradeoff: 提示里点名结构角色+API vs 让 AI 自由发挥接口设计
options_en: Just say 'make it elegant and not too verbose'.
The structures' names and roles, plus the class API's signatures and return values.
Tell the AI to skip all tests and produce the implementation first.
Let the AI guess the requirements, complexity targets, and interface all by itself.

termDefinitions.meaning: 调用者与实现之间约定好的方法签名和返回值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: API stands for Application Programming Interface, the agreed method signatures and return values a caller can rely on.

optionExplanations: 「优雅」是主观词，AI 拿不到任何可执行的技术约束，只能自己瞎猜接口。
把每个结构的角色和方法签名/返回值都说清楚，AI 补代码时就不用自己猜接口，一次成型的概率更高。
跳过测试是个次要的顺序问题，不影响 AI 是否真的理解你要的结构组合。
把需求和接口判断权都交给 AI，等于让它替你做设计决定，很可能走向隐藏组合的内置捷径。
optionExplanations_en: "Make it elegant" is subjective — it gives the AI no actionable constraint, so it just guesses at an interface.
Spell out which structure does what and the exact method signatures it must expose — leave nothing for the AI to invent, so first drafts land correctly more often.
Skipping tests is a secondary ordering detail; it says nothing about whether the AI actually grasps the structural design you're going for.
Handing the requirement judgment entirely to the AI means it makes the design decision for you, likely reaching for a built-in shortcut that hides the composition.

q: AI 对 LRU 或有序缓存题直接用了 `OrderedDict`，在面试中最大的风险是什么？
q_en: If the AI uses `OrderedDict` directly for an LRU or ordered-cache problem, what is the biggest interview risk?
options: 复杂度一定错误
代码一定无法运行
隐藏了哈希表 + 链表的组合，无法展示你理解设计
Python 不支持 OrderedDict
why: 内置结构在生产中可能很好，但面试题往往考组合能力。你可以提到内置方案，然后明确从零实现以展示底层设计。
why_en: Built-ins may be practical but can hide the composition the interviewer is trying to evaluate.
options_en: The complexity is guaranteed to be wrong.
The code is guaranteed not to run.
It hides the hash-map-plus-linked-list composition, so you can't demonstrate you understand the design.
Python doesn't support OrderedDict.

termDefinitions.meaning: Python 内置的有序字典，内部已经用哈希表+双向链表实现，隐藏了组合过程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: OrderedDict is a Python built-in ordered dictionary that already combines a hash map and a doubly linked list internally.

termDefinitions.meaning: 键值映射结构，平均 O(1) 按 key 查找、插入、删除。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash map is a key-value structure offering average O(1) lookup, insert, and delete by key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个节点同时保存前驱和后继指针，可 O(1) 在已知节点处插入或删除。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A doubly linked list keeps prev and next pointers on every node, allowing O(1) insert or delete at a known node.

termDefinitions.meaning: 最近最少使用缓存淘汰策略：优先淘汰最久没被访问的数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LRU stands for Least Recently Used, a cache policy that evicts the item that has not been accessed for the longest time.

optionExplanations: OrderedDict 的 get/move_to_end 本身就是 O(1)，复杂度不是问题所在。
OrderedDict 实现良好，换用它代码通常照样能正常跑起来。
面试官只能看到一次方法调用，看不到你对哈希表+链表这套组合的理解，这才是内置捷径最大的风险。
OrderedDict 是 Python 标准库自带的类型，这个说法本身不成立。
optionExplanations_en: OrderedDict's get and move_to_end are already O(1), so complexity was never the issue.
OrderedDict is well implemented, so code using it typically runs just fine.
The interviewer only sees a single method call, not your grasp of the hash-map-plus-list composition — that is the real risk of the built-in shortcut.
OrderedDict has always been part of the Python standard library, so that claim is simply false.
scenario: 面试官出 LRU 题并说明想看你的结构设计推理，AI 却用一行 `OrderedDict` 解决。
scenario_en: The interviewer gives you LRU and says they want your structure-design reasoning, but the AI solves it with a one-line OrderedDict.

q: 审查 AI 生成的数据结构实现时，应优先检查哪些点？
q_en: When reviewing AI-generated data-structure code, what should you check first?
options: 组合结构的不变量是否在每个操作后仍成立
空结构、单元素、重复 key、越界等不开心路径
是否偷偷用了隐藏组合的内置捷径
所有变量名是否足够长
why: 这类题的正确性在边界操作和结构同步上。变量名不是主要风险，除非它影响你解释代码。
why_en: Verify invariants, unhappy paths, and hidden shortcuts before trusting AI-generated data-structure code.
options_en: Whether the composed structure's invariant still holds after every operation.
Empty structure, single element, duplicate key, out-of-bounds index, and other unhappy paths.
Whether it quietly used a built-in shortcut that hides the composition.
Whether every variable name is long enough.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个组合结构在每次操作后都必须仍然成立的性质。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An invariant is a property that must still hold true after every operation on a composed structure.

termDefinitions.meaning: Python 内置的有序字典，内部已经用哈希表+双向链表实现，隐藏了组合过程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: OrderedDict is a Python built-in ordered dictionary that already combines a hash map and a doubly linked list internally.

optionExplanations: 先查不变量：跨结构的状态如果在某次操作后就对不上了，AI 的 happy path 代码会带着隐藏 bug 上线。
空结构、单元素、重复 key、越界这些输入，正是 AI 第一版代码最容易悄悄出错的地方。
确认有没有偷偷换成内置捷径掩盖了组合过程，否则设计其实没有真正被展示出来。
变量名长度不影响状态是否同步，也不是正确性审查该花时间的地方。
optionExplanations_en: Check the invariant first — if cross-structure state falls out of sync after any operation, the AI's happy-path code ships with a hidden bug.
Empty structures, single elements, duplicate keys, and out-of-bounds inputs are exactly where the AI's first draft tends to break silently.
Confirm it did not quietly swap in a built-in shortcut that hides the composition, or the design was never actually demonstrated.
Variable-name length doesn't affect whether state stays in sync, and it isn't where a correctness review should spend time.
scenario: 只剩 5 分钟审查 AI 写的 LRU 与双堆实现，你必须先看最可能藏 bug 的地方。
scenario_en: With five minutes left to review the AI's LRU and two-heap code, you must look first where bugs are most likely to hide.

q: 填空：LRU 的核心不变量。
q_en: Fill in the blank: the core LRU invariant.
text: LRU 中，{{哈希表和链表}}必须包含同一组 key，且链表顺序必须反映{{最近访问顺序}}。
why: 每个 get/put 都要维持这个不变量。调试时不要只看返回值，也要追踪两个结构是否仍同步。
why_en: The LRU invariant is that the map and list contain the same keys and the list encodes recency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 最近最少使用缓存淘汰策略：优先淘汰最久没被访问的数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LRU stands for Least Recently Used, a cache policy that evicts the item that has not been accessed for the longest time.

q: 填空：MedianFinder 的核心不变量。
q_en: Fill in the blank: the core MedianFinder invariant.
text: MedianFinder 中，低半堆 `lo` 的元素都应{{小于等于}}高半堆 `hi` 的元素，且 `lo` 的大小应{{等于 hi 或只多一个}}。
why: 这两个不变量让 `findMedian` 不需要扫描或排序。只要堆顶能代表中间元素，查询就是 O(1)。
why_en: MedianFinder's ordering and size invariants make the median readable directly from heap tops.

scenario: AI 写完 LRU，你要用最小操作序列验证顺序更新和淘汰。
scenario_en: The AI has finished an LRU implementation, and you want the smallest operation trace to verify recency updates and eviction.
q: 哪组测试最能暴露核心问题？
q_en: Which test best exposes the core issue?
options: 只检查类名字符串拼写是否正确，不做任何调用
只初始化一个空对象，从头到尾不调用 get 或 put
只反复对一个从始至终都不存在的 key 调用 get
插入 3 个，访问第 1 个，再插入第 4 个，看淘汰谁
why: 这个序列同时测试新增、访问移动到头部、超容量淘汰和 map/list 同步。它比单个 happy path 更有信息量。
why_en: A short LRU trace with access before eviction tests recency movement and synchronization.
whenOtherWins: 如果问题主要是空缓存行为，再单独补 get-miss 和 capacity 为 0 或 1 的测试。
options_en: Only check the class name is spelled right, without making any calls.
Only initialize an empty object and never call get or put at all.
Only call get repeatedly on a key that never existed.
Insert 3 items, access the first, insert a 4th, and see which one gets evicted.

termDefinitions.meaning: 最近最少使用缓存淘汰策略：优先淘汰最久没被访问的数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LRU stands for Least Recently Used, a cache policy that evicts the item that has not been accessed for the longest time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 键值映射结构，平均 O(1) 按 key 查找、插入、删除。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash map is a key-value structure offering average O(1) lookup, insert, and delete by key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个节点同时保存前驱和后继指针，可 O(1) 在已知节点处插入或删除。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A doubly linked list keeps prev and next pointers on every node, allowing O(1) insert or delete at a known node.

tradeoff: 单条最短序列换高信息量 vs 只测单一分支的弱测试

Re-sort every node.

scenario: 数据构建一次后不再更新，之后要大量按范围查询。

q: 优先考虑哪种简单方案？
q_en: Which simple approach should you consider first?
options: LRU Cache
每次随机扫描未排序数组
排序数组 + 二分
Union-Find
why: 静态数据可以把维护成本前置到一次排序，然后用二分高效查询。不要为了“高级”而上动态树结构。
why_en: For static range queries, a sorted array plus binary search can beat heavier dynamic structures.
whenOtherWins: 如果数据频繁插入删除，排序数组维护成本高，应考虑平衡树或有序集合。
tradeoff: 一次排序换后续 O(log n) 查询简单 vs 动态更新场景下的维护成本
options_en: An LRU cache.
Randomly scan an unsorted array every time.
A sorted array plus binary search.
Union-Find.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在有序数据上每次排除一半候选，O(log n) 定位目标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Binary search halves the candidate range each step, locating a target in O(log n) time on sorted data.

termDefinitions.meaning: 最近最少使用缓存淘汰策略：优先淘汰最久没被访问的数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LRU stands for Least Recently Used, a cache policy that evicts the item that has not been accessed for the longest time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 并查集：维护一组不相交集合，支持合并（union）和查询代表元（find）。

optionExplanations: LRU 解决的是访问顺序淘汰，跟数据构建一次后按范围查询完全不是一回事。
不排序直接扫描，每次查询都要 O(n)，数据量一大就明显吃力。
数据只构建一次、之后大量按范围查，先花一次 O(n log n) 排序，之后每次查询只要 O(log n) 二分，维护成本最低。
Union-Find 管的是分组合并，跟按范围查值没有关系。
optionExplanations_en: LRU governs recency-based eviction, an entirely different job from scanning fixed data by range.
Scanning an unsorted array every time costs O(n) per query, noticeably slow once data grows.
Data built once, queried heavily: one O(n log n) sort up front, then every query is O(log n) via binary search — the cheapest option to maintain.
Union-Find governs group merging, a different concern from querying data by range.

q: 哪几种“结构组合”值得提前练熟？
q_en: Which structure compositions are worth drilling in advance?
options: 哈希表 + 双向链表
两个堆
Union-Find 的 parent + rank
只用一个正则表达式解决所有数据结构题
why: 这些组合分别对应 LRU、中位数流和动态连通性。它们是少数值得提前练熟的高频结构。
why_en: Common interview compositions include map plus linked list, two heaps, and Union-Find parent plus rank arrays.
options_en: A hash map plus a doubly linked list.
Two heaps.
Union-Find's parent array plus rank array.
Solve every data-structure problem with just one regex.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个节点同时保存前驱和后继指针，可 O(1) 在已知节点处插入或删除。

optionExplanations: 哈希表管查找、链表管顺序，看到「淘汰最旧」就该反射性想到这对搭配。
低半最大堆、高半最小堆，看到「流式求中位数」就该反射性想到这对堆。
parent 数组记根、rank 数组控树高，看到「边逐条到达判断同组」就该反射性想到这对字段。
正则只做文本匹配，不提供任何维护状态或组合结构的能力。
optionExplanations_en: Seeing 'evict the oldest' should point you straight at a hash map for lookup paired with a list for order.
A running median problem is the classic trigger for splitting data across two heaps, max on the low side and min on the high side.
When edges stream in and you only need same-group checks, reach for Union-Find's parent-plus-rank pair.
Regex only matches text; it offers no way to maintain state or compose structures.

scenario_en: Preparing for an AI-assisted coding interview, you only have time to drill a handful of operation-to-structure combinations.

q: 手写双向链表时，为什么“哨兵节点”是值得主动提示 AI 的实现细节？
q_en: When hand-writing a doubly linked list, why are sentinel nodes worth explicitly prompting the AI to use?
options: 它砍掉空表、删头尾、删最后一个元素的分支
它能把链表的所有操作变成 O(log n)
它可以整个替代哈希表的 key 索引作用
它主要用于检测图里是否存在环
why: 哨兵节点不会改变设计本质，但能显著降低边界 bug 率。AI 不一定总会默认使用，所以值得明确说出。
why_en: Sentinels simplify linked-list edge cases and reduce implementation bugs.
options_en: It removes the branches for an empty list, head or tail removal, and the last remaining node.
It turns every linked-list operation into O(log n).
It can replace the hash map's key-index role entirely.
It's mainly used to detect whether a graph has a cycle.

termDefinitions.meaning: 链表头尾各放一个不存数据的占位节点，让插入/删除不用判断空表或首尾特殊情况。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A sentinel node is a placeholder at the head or tail of a list that removes special-case branches for empty lists or boundary edits.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个节点同时保存前驱和后继指针，可 O(1) 在已知节点处插入或删除。

环检测通常靠访问标记或 Union-Find，跟链表哨兵节点没有关系。
optionExplanations_en: Hand-written lists most often bug out on edges — empty list, head/tail removal, one remaining node — sentinels remove those branches outright, worth telling the AI explicitly.
Sentinels don't change any operation's time complexity; that still comes from the hash map and list themselves.
Without sentinels, key lookup still relies on the hash map — sentinels cannot replace it.
Cycle detection usually relies on visited marks or Union-Find, unrelated to list sentinels.
scenario: 让 AI 从零手写 LRU 的双向链表，最怕空表、删头尾、删最后一个元素这些边界写错。
scenario_en: You ask the AI to hand-write LRU's doubly linked list, and the risk is edge cases: empty list, head or tail removal, the last node.

scenario: 问题是“随着朋友关系流入，维护用户分组”；不是求一条具体路径，也不是依赖排序。

q: 你应该怎样向面试官区分模式？
q_en: How should you distinguish the pattern for the interviewer?
options: 必须用回溯法枚举所有可能的分组组合方式并逐一剪枝
这属于文本处理里的正则表达式解析类问题
这是求两点之间带权重的单源最短路径问题
Union-Find 在线连通性，不是路径搜索
why: 数据结构设计关注的是如何维护状态以支持操作。在线合并分组正是 Union-Find 的强项。

whenOtherWins: 如果题目改成“从 A 到 B 的最短连接路径是什么”，就需要图搜索而不是只维护同组关系。

This is a regex parsing problem from text processing.
This is a single-source shortest-path problem with edge weights.
Union-Find online connectivity, not a path search.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: Union-Find, or disjoint-set union, maintains groups of elements and supports merging groups and finding a group's representative.

termDefinitions.meaning: 广度优先搜索：按层扩展，先访问离起点近的节点。

optionExplanations: 这道题有近似 O(1) 的高效解法，回溯枚举所有分组只会让复杂度爆炸，没必要。
问题是维护朋友关系分组，不是文本模式匹配，正则用不上力。

q: 把 MedianFinder 的一次插入逻辑按正确顺序排列。
q_en: Put one MedianFinder insertion flow in the correct order.
steps: 如果高半堆比低半堆大，把高半堆顶移回低半堆。

把低半堆的最大元素移到高半堆，确保两边顺序关系。
保持低半堆大小等于或只比高半堆多一个。
why: 这套流程同时维护顺序不变量和大小不变量。查询逻辑只有在不变量成立时才是 O(1) 正确的。
why_en: Median insertion pushes through the lower heap, moves the boundary element up, rebalances sizes, and then reads the median from tops.

因为购物清单本身也可以按价格排序
因为所有设计题最后都只考查一个列表
因为 AI 无法独立实现链表、堆这些结构

Because a shopping list can itself be sorted by price.
Because every design problem ends up testing a single list.
Because the AI can't implement linked lists or heaps on its own.

并非所有题目都只考一个列表，这个比喻讲的是推导方式，不是表面形式。
AI 完全擅长实现链表、堆、并查集这些基础结构，这个说法本身不成立。

Whether a shopping list can be sorted is beside the point; what matters is picking one capability per requirement.
Not every problem tests just a single list; the metaphor is about the reasoning process, not a surface form.
The AI is perfectly capable of implementing linked lists, heaps, and union-find, so that claim is simply false.

单个基础结构，如果它已经覆盖全部操作

why_en: Good design answers mention simpler arrays, single primitives, and built-ins before committing to custom composition.
options_en: A plain array or list, especially when input is bounded and reads dominate writes.
A single primitive, if it already covers every operation.
A language built-in, such as OrderedDict or LinkedHashMap.
You must always compose three structures regardless of requirements.

OrderedDict、LinkedHashMap 这类内置结构值得在面试里提到，展示你知道有更省事的路径，但面试往往想看你从零组合。

If one primitive already covers every required operation, composing more just adds complexity for no reason.
Built-ins like OrderedDict or LinkedHashMap are worth naming to show you know the easy path exists, even though the interview wants to see you compose it yourself.
Composition should follow the actual operations needed; forcing three structures regardless of requirements is a sign of over-engineering.
scenario: 设计题要 O(1) 查找 + 顺序淘汰，你在给出组合结构前要先交代排除了哪些更简单方案。

q: 数据结构设计题里，面试官最想看到你做什么？
q_en: In a data-structure design question, what does the interviewer most want to see you do?
options: 直接接受 AI 给出的第一版代码就交卷
把需求转成操作清单，命名不变量，驱动 AI
只背结构名字，不解释为什么这样组合

why: AI 能写链表、堆和并查集，但它不能替你证明你理解为什么这么组合。你的价值在结构选择、API 约束和不变量验证。
why_en: Interviewers want to see you derive the composition, name its invariants, and direct the AI implementation.
options_en: Just accept the AI's first draft and call it done.
Turn requirements into an operation list, name the invariant, and direct the AI.
Recite structure names without explaining why they compose that way.
Actively avoid discussing edge cases like an empty list or duplicate keys.
optionExplanations: 照单全收 AI 的第一版代码，面试官看到的只是你在验收，看不到你自己的判断过程。

只背结构名字换不来对权衡的理解，面试官一追问为什么选它就答不上来。

optionExplanations_en: Rubber-stamping the AI's first draft means the interviewer only sees you approving output, not your own judgment.
List the operations, name the invariant, then direct the AI's build — that's what separates reciting a pattern from truly understanding it.
Reciting structure names alone doesn't demonstrate understanding the tradeoffs, and falls apart the moment someone asks why you chose it.

scenario: AI 辅助的面试里，链表、堆、并查集的标准实现 AI 已经能秒写出来。

q_en: If you ask for the implementation and the tests in one prompt, what most likely goes wrong?

测试照着这版实现的行为写，淘汰 bug 被写成「预期」
生成的测试一定跑不起来，因为缺测试框架的 import 和配置
实现会变慢，AI 为迎合测试插入额外的复杂度检查与日志
options_en: The AI refuses to produce two pieces of code at once, forcing a second round anyway.
The tests get written to match this implementation, so an eviction bug becomes the 'expected' result.
The generated tests can never run because the test framework import and config are missing.
The implementation gets slower because the AI adds extra complexity checks and logging for the tests.
optionExplanations: AI 一次生成实现加测试完全没问题，问题不在它能不能，而在这两段是不是互相独立。
测试是同一次生成里照着实现写的，实现漏删尾节点，测试的断言就照抄这个错误行为，跑绿灯却什么也没验证。
import 缺失是一眼能看出来、一行能补上的小问题，不是这个顺序带来的真实风险。
为测试加日志属于风格问题；先出实现要防的是正确性被测试反向背书，不是性能。
optionExplanations_en: The AI has no trouble emitting both at once — the issue isn't capability, it's whether the two are independent.
Written in the same pass, the tests copy the implementation's behavior, so a missed tail deletion becomes a green assertion that verifies nothing.
A missing import is visible at a glance and fixed in one line — not the real risk of this ordering.
Extra logging is a style issue; asking for the implementation first guards correctness, not speed.
why: 先要实现、自己审一遍、再要测试：测试的价值在于挑战实现，而不是描述它。代价是多一轮往返，换来 bug 不会被测试盖章。
why_en: Ask for the structure first, review it yourself, then ask for tests — otherwise the tests just describe the bug instead of catching it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 最近最少使用：容量满时淘汰最久没被访问的那条。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LRU stands for Least Recently Used: when the cache is full, it evicts the entry untouched for the longest time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 缓存超容量时移除一条旧条目的动作。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Eviction is removing an old entry when the cache exceeds its capacity.

scenario: LRU 用哈希表 key→节点 加双向链表，AI 生成的 Node 只有 val、prev、next 三个字段。
scenario_en: The LRU pairs a key-to-node hash map with a doubly-linked list, but the AI's Node only carries val, prev, and next.
q: 容量满触发淘汰时，Node 不存 key 会怎么坏？
q_en: When the cache overflows and evicts, how does a Node without a key break?
options: 链表的尾节点摘不下来，链表长度会无限增长
拿到尾节点却反查不出 key，哈希表条目删不掉
get 会永远返回 -1，因为节点里没有 key 可以比对
淘汰顺序退化成先进先出，刚访问过的节点反而被删
options_en: The tail node can't be unlinked, so the list grows without bound.
You hold the tail node but can't recover its key, so the hash-map entry is never deleted.
get always returns -1 because the node has no key to compare against.
Eviction degrades to first-in-first-out, throwing out nodes you just touched.
optionExplanations: 摘链只靠 prev/next 指针，不需要 key，链表这一侧其实是干净的。
淘汰从 tail.prev 拿到的是节点对象，而哈希表是按 key 索引的；没有 node.key 就只能全表扫描才能找到那条要删的映射。
get 是拿外部传进来的 key 去查哈希表，节点里存不存 key 不影响这条路径。
顺序由链表位置决定，get 时把节点移到头部这条逻辑与 key 字段无关。
optionExplanations_en: Unlinking only needs the prev/next pointers, so the list side is actually fine.
Eviction hands you the node object from tail.prev, but the map is indexed by key — without node.key you'd have to scan the whole map to find that entry.
get looks up the caller's key in the hash map, so whether the node stores a key doesn't affect that path.
Order comes from list position; moving a node to the head on get has nothing to do with the key field.
why: 淘汰时你手上只有尾节点指针，删哈希表条目却要 key 才能定位，所以 Node 必须自带 key 让反查是 O(1)。代价是每个节点多存一份 key 的内存。
why_en: On eviction you only hold the tail node, but deleting the map entry needs its key — so the node carries the key, at the cost of storing it twice.
codeSample:
if len(self.cache) > self.cap:
    lru = self.tail.prev      # 只拿到节点对象
    self._remove(lru)         # 摘链只用 prev/next
    del self.cache[lru.key]   # 删哈希表条目必须靠 node.key 反查

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个节点同时存前驱和后继指针，因此已知节点时能 O(1) 摘除。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A doubly-linked list stores both a previous and a next pointer per node, so a known node can be unlinked in constant time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 哈希表里一条 key 到值的映射；不按 key 删就会残留。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash-map entry is one key-to-value mapping, and it can only be deleted by its key.

scenario: MedianFinder 的 lo 要当最大堆存下半部分，你的 prompt 没提 Python 的 heapq 只有最小堆。
scenario_en: In MedianFinder, lo must act as a max-heap over the lower half, but your prompt never mentioned that Python's heapq is min-only.
q: AI 直接把 heapq 当 lo 的最大堆用，会怎么坏？
q_en: If the AI uses heapq directly as lo's max-heap, how does it break?
options: heappush 会直接抛出类型错误，因为堆里被存进了负数
lo 的堆顶变成下半部分的最小值，中位数读错
插入退化成 O(n)，因为堆每次都要整体重建再重新取顶
两个堆的大小平衡被打破，但中位数结果依然正确
options_en: heappush raises a type error outright because negative numbers were pushed into the heap.
lo's top becomes the smallest of the lower half, so the median is wrong.
Insertion degrades to O(n) because the heap is fully rebuilt and re-topped on every push.
The size balance between the two heaps breaks, yet the median still comes out correct.
optionExplanations: 存负数正是要主动做的技巧，heapq 对负数毫无意见，不会报错。
findMedian 要读的是下半部分里最大的那个数，最小堆的堆顶恰好是最小的那个，元素个数为奇数时直接返回错值。
堆的插入本来就是 O(log n) 的上浮，用错方向不改变复杂度，只改变堆顶是谁。
反了：大小平衡逻辑照常跑，坏的是堆顶语义，中位数才是错的那个。
optionExplanations_en: Pushing negated values is the intended trick, and heapq is perfectly happy with negative numbers.
findMedian needs the largest value in the lower half, but a min-heap's top is the smallest — so an odd-sized structure returns a wrong number outright.
Heap insertion is a sift-up either way; the wrong direction changes which element sits on top, not the complexity.
It's the reverse: the balancing still runs, and it's the median that comes out wrong.
why: heapq 只有最小堆，最大堆要靠存负值模拟，而 lo 的堆顶必须是下半部分的最大值。代价是每次进出都要取负，可读性下降，所以要在 prompt 里点名。
why_en: Python's heapq is min-only, so you simulate a max-heap by pushing negated values — it costs readability, which is exactly why you say it in the prompt.

termDefinitions.meaning: Python 标准库的堆模块，只提供最小堆操作。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: heapq is Python's standard-library heap module, and it only provides min-heap operations.

termDefinitions.meaning: 堆里可以 O(1) 读到的那个极值元素。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The heap top is the extreme element that can be read in constant time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 堆顶始终是当前最大值的堆。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A max-heap is a heap whose top is always the current largest value.

scenario: Union-Find 里每个元素存一个 parent 指针，find 沿指针走到根，union 让一个根指向另一个根。
scenario_en: In union-find each element stores a parent pointer, find walks those pointers to the root, and union points one root at the other.
q: 不做路径压缩时，这套指针机制最坏会退化成什么？
q_en: Without path compression, what does this pointer scheme degrade into at worst?
options: 同一个集合里出现两个根，connected 的判断开始随机出错
树退化成一条长链，find 要沿指针一路走 O(n) 步
union 会把指针接成环，find 沿着环一直走不到根而死循环
内存翻倍，因为每个元素还要额外维护一份子节点列表
options_en: One set ends up with two roots, so connected starts giving random answers.
The tree degenerates into a long chain, so find walks O(n) pointers.
union links the pointers into a cycle, so find loops forever without reaching a root.
Memory doubles because every element also keeps a list of its children.
optionExplanations: union 永远是把一个根挂到另一个根下面，合并后集合里只剩一个根，唯一性不会被破坏。
每次都把根挂到链尾时，parent 指针连成一条长链，find 得从叶子一跳一跳走到根，单次操作就是元素总数量级。
只连根到根不会成环；成环要靠把根挂到自己子树里的节点，标准 union 不会这么做。
parent 数组只存向上的指针，没有子节点列表，退化影响的是深度不是内存。
optionExplanations_en: union always hangs one root under another, so a merged set still has exactly one root.
When every merge lands at the end of the chain, the parent pointers form a long line and find hops from leaf to root once per element.
Linking root to root can't create a cycle — that would need attaching a root under its own subtree, which standard union never does.
The parent array only stores upward pointers, so degradation costs depth, not memory.
why: find 的成本就是从元素走到根的跳数，链有多长就走多少步。路径压缩把沿途每个节点直接改指向根，下次一跳到位，代价是 find 从只读操作变成会写 parent 数组的操作。
why_en: find costs one hop per level up to the root, so path compression rewires the whole path straight to the root — which turns a read into a write.
codeSample:
def find(self, x: int) -> int:
    if self.parent[x] != x:              # x 不是根就继续往上走
        self.parent[x] = self.find(self.parent[x])  # 路径压缩：回来时改指向根
    return self.parent[x]

termDefinitions.meaning: find 找到根后，把这条路径上的每个节点直接指向根，下次查询一跳到位。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Path compression repoints every node on the lookup path directly at the root, so the next find takes a single hop.

termDefinitions.meaning: 合并时把较矮的树挂到较高的树下面，避免树越长越深。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Union by rank attaches the shorter tree under the taller one so the trees stay shallow.

termDefinitions.meaning: parent 指向自己的那个元素，用作整个集合的代表。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The root is the element whose parent is itself, and it serves as the identifier for the whole set.

scenario: 你要 AI 写 UnionFind 来数图里有多少连通分量，prompt 里没提「已连通时 union 返回 False」，主路径跑通了。
scenario_en: You asked the AI for a UnionFind to count connected components but never said union should return False when the two are already connected; the happy path runs.
q: 把这条边界留到生成之后再补，代价是什么？
q_en: What does it cost to bolt that edge case on after generation instead of stating it upfront?
options: 冗余边也算成一次有效合并，连通分量数每遇一条就多减一次
AI 会拒绝改动已经生成好的类，只能整份重写一遍
union 的复杂度退化，因为要重新遍历所有元素确认状态
只是少打了一行返回值，行为上跟写清楚了没有区别
options_en: A redundant edge counts as a real merge, so the component count drops once too often.
The AI refuses to touch a class it already generated, forcing a full rewrite.
union's complexity degrades because it must rescan every element to confirm state.
It's just one missing return line, so the behavior is identical either way.
optionExplanations: 连通分量数的算法是「从 n 开始，每次 union 返回 True 就减一」；两端本来就同根却还返回 True，计数就被多减，结果比真实值小。
追加要求让 AI 改一个方法完全没问题，真正的成本是改完要重新核对调用点。
先比较两个根再决定合不合并，本来就是 find 两次的开销，跟复杂度退化无关。
这条返回值是给调用方用的信号，缺了它计数和冗余边检测都会静默算错，不是格式问题。
optionExplanations_en: Counting components means starting at n and subtracting one whenever union returns True — returning True for an already-merged pair over-subtracts.
Asking the AI to amend one method is fine; the real cost is re-verifying every caller afterwards.
Comparing the two roots before merging is just two finds, which has nothing to do with complexity.
That return value is a signal to the caller — without it, component counts and redundant-edge detection are silently wrong.
why: 边界条件写进 prompt 是让 AI 一次生成对；事后补丁要重新验证不变量，还容易漏掉依赖这个返回值的调用点。代价只是 prompt 多一句话。
why_en: Naming edge cases in the prompt gets it right the first time — patching later means re-verifying the invariant and every caller that reads the return value.

termDefinitions.meaning: 图里互相可达的一组节点；数它就是数图被分成了几块。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A connected component is a group of mutually reachable nodes, so counting them tells you how many pieces the graph has.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两端本来就已经在同一集合里的边，加它不改变分组。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A redundant edge connects two nodes already in the same set, so adding it changes nothing.

scenario: AI 写完双堆 MedianFinder，你只有时间手动 trace 一遍：依次 add 1、3、2，每步核对中位数。
scenario_en: The AI finished the two-heap MedianFinder and you only have time for one manual trace: add 1, then 3, then 2, checking the median each step.
q: 哪一步才真正暴露漏写的那次回移？
q_en: Which step actually exposes a missing rebalance step?
options: 加完 1 之后：只有一个元素，取 lo 的堆顶返回 1
加完 3 之后：两边各一个，返回两个堆顶的平均值 2
加完 2 之后：正确是 2，漏回移会读成 1.5
三步都看不出来，要连续加到十个数才显出堆大小差
options_en: After adding 1: with a single element you read lo's top and get 1.
After adding 3: one element on each side, so you average the two tops and get 2.
After adding 2: the answer should be 2, but a missing rebalance reads 1.5.
None of the three show it — you need ten numbers before the size gap appears.
optionExplanations: 第一步只走了「push 进 lo、弹到 hi、再弹回来」的对称路径，任何实现都能过。
第二步 lo 和 hi 各一个元素，走的还是主路径，最后那个 if 条件根本没被触发。
第三步 push 完再弹给 hi，hi 变成 2 个而 lo 只剩 1 个，这是第一次需要把 hi 的堆顶弹回 lo；漏了就用两个堆顶取平均，答案从 2 变成 1.5。
恰恰相反，三个数就足以触发一次不平衡，这也是选这条 trace 的原因。
optionExplanations_en: The first step only walks the symmetric push-pop-push path, which any implementation survives.
With one element on each side, the second step still takes the main path and never trips the final if.
On the third add, hi ends up with two elements to lo's one — the first time the top must move back; skip it and averaging the tops turns 2 into 1.5.
The opposite is true: three numbers are enough to force one imbalance, which is why this trace is chosen.
why: lo 必须始终等于或多于 hi 一个，findMedian 才能靠堆顶判断；这条 trace 用最少三个数逼出那次回移。代价是它测不到重复值和删除这类后续要求。
why_en: lo must hold the same number of elements as hi or exactly one more, and three numbers is the shortest trace that forces the rebalance branch to run.

termDefinitions.meaning: 当高半堆比低半堆多时，把高半堆的堆顶弹回低半堆，恢复大小不变量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Rebalancing moves the upper heap's top back into the lower heap whenever the upper heap grows larger, restoring the size invariant.

termDefinitions.meaning: 手工按顺序执行几步操作，每步核对状态是否符合预期。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A trace means stepping through a few operations by hand and checking the state after each one.

scenario: 题目给一批任务和它们之间的依赖关系，要求输出一个可以照着执行的顺序。
scenario_en: The problem hands you a set of tasks with dependencies between them and asks for an order you can execute them in.
q: 这题归到哪个模式，为什么不是数据结构设计？
q_en: Which pattern is this, and why isn't it data structure design?
options: 数据结构设计：设计一个能 O(1) 查某个任务依赖谁的类
拓扑排序：难点是顺着依赖方向遍历图产出顺序
Union-Find：把有依赖关系的任务合并进同一个分组
图搜索最短路：找出依赖链上代价最小的那条路径
options_en: Data structure design: build a class that answers 'what does this task depend on' in O(1).
Topological sort: the work is walking the graph along dependency direction to emit an order.
Union-find: merge tasks that depend on each other into the same group.
Shortest-path graph search: find the cheapest chain through the dependencies.
optionExplanations: 依赖关系用一个邻接表存就够了，存法根本不是瓶颈，所以这题不落在数据结构设计里。
要产出的是一个满足所有先后约束的执行序列，这正是拓扑排序的输出形状。
Union-Find 只记录谁和谁连通，丢掉了边的方向，因此答不了「A 必须在 B 之前」。
题目没有边权，也不求某两点之间的最短路，最短路算法在这里无事可做。
optionExplanations_en: An adjacency list stores the dependencies fine — how you store them isn't the bottleneck here.
The output is an execution sequence satisfying every precedence constraint, which is exactly what a topological sort produces.
Union-find only records who is connected to whom and discards edge direction, so it can't say 'A must come before B'.
There are no edge weights and no source-to-target query, so a shortest-path algorithm has nothing to do.
why: 数据结构设计只有在「怎么存」成为瓶颈时才对；这题的难点是按边的方向产出顺序。代价是拓扑排序要先建图并统计入度，比直接扫一遍任务列表重。
why_en: Data structure design applies when storage is the bottleneck; here the hard part is emitting an order that respects edge direction, so it's a topological sort.
tradeoff: 数据结构设计（存法是瓶颈）vs 拓扑排序（顺序产出是瓶颈）

termDefinitions.meaning: 对有向无环图给出一个顺序，使每条边的起点都排在终点之前。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A topological sort produces an ordering of a directed acyclic graph in which every edge points from an earlier item to a later one.

termDefinitions.meaning: 并查集：维护元素的分组，支持合并两组和查询两个元素是否同组。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Union-find is a disjoint-set structure that merges groups and answers whether two elements belong to the same group.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用每个节点的出边列表来存图的方式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An adjacency list stores a graph as, for each node, the list of edges leaving it.
